integrity: The published defining-zero set is reconstructed over an explicit \(\mathbb F_{16}\) model, yielding a degree-ten generator over \(\mathbb F_4\). Rank, Euclidean self-orthogonality, minimum distance \(8\), and the complete \(1024\)-word distribution are checked before the higher-support census. All \(12277\) positive-dimensional message subspaces are enumerated exactly once in reduced-row-echelon form.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact finite higher-support census for the \(q=4,m=2\) code in Example 4.9. It does not give an all-parameter formula for the source families and does not classify subcodes up to automorphism.
title: Complete higher-support profile of the optimal quaternary self-orthogonal cyclic \([15,5,8]\) code
